info.description:
AI web extraction for the ProductCraft platform: submit a URL and a JSON Schema, get back structured JSON. Jobs run asynchronously; poll the job or subscribe a webhook endpoint for its result.

## Rate limits

Every `/v1` route is limited per client IP to 20 requests per second and 600 per minute. Each response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit-short`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining-short`, `X-RateLimit-Reset-short` (the one-second window) and the same three with `-long` (the one-minute window). Over either limit the response is `429` with code `RATE_LIMITED` and a `Retry-After` header in seconds.
info.title: Trawl API

post.description: Queues an extraction: an agent browses from `suggested_urls` (or searches when there are none) and returns JSON matching `json_schema`. The job starts `queued`; poll `GET /jobs/{id}` until `status` is `succeeded`, `failed` or `cancelled`, or subscribe a webhook endpoint to `job.succeeded` / `job.failed`. Each agent step uses one credit; a workspace at zero credits gets 402. Send an `Idempotency-Key` so a retried request never queues a second job.

parameters.description: Pass a key (1..256 chars, [A-Za-z0-9_\-:]) to make retries safe — replays return the original response for 24h.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

Idempotent-Replay.description: `true` when this response is a replay of an earlier request with the same `Idempotency-Key`.

400.description: Invalid JSON Schema (must be a non-empty `type: object`).

403.description: Caller lacks `trawl.create`, or workspace has not enabled the `trawl` service.

409.description: Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key).

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying with the same key (sent with `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS`).

429.description: Rate limited. `RATE_LIMITED` — submission window exceeded (default 10/min per workspace); the `Retry-After` header gives the seconds until the window resets. `TOO_MANY_ACTIVE_JOBS` — too many queued/running jobs (default 25); retry once some finish. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds.

get.description: The job with its current `status`, and `result` (JSON matching the job's `json_schema`) once it has `succeeded` or `error` once it has `failed`. Poll this until `status` is terminal; every read is free.
